# Change

Describe the user-visible result or engineering contract, implementation stage, and acceptance IDs addressed. Link the updated evidence rows. For tooling/docs-only work, state that no gameplay criterion is claimed complete.

## Documentation

Link updated guides, API contracts, examples, or ADRs. If none apply, explain why.

## Verification

List exact commands and outcomes, relevant regression/behavior tests, and required checks that could not run. Include benchmark evidence for performance-sensitive changes.

## Compatibility and limitations

Describe affected saved data, migrations, script APIs, resource ownership, segment permissions, or supported integrations. State concrete remaining limitations.

## Review

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and failure behavior are covered.
- [ ] Applicable documentation and tests are updated.
- [ ] Required checks passed, or blocked checks are explicitly identified above.
- [ ] No verification gate was weakened to hide a failure.

These statements aid review; they do not replace CI results or evidence.
